.formLabel { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.formInput, .formSelect { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); background: var(--primary-form-bg); color: var(--primary-text); font-size: 14px; outline: none; }

@media (max-width: 599px) {
 .accountTitle { font-size: 22px; }
 .modelKeyRow { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }
}

.pgWrapper { width: 100%; padding: 32px; box-sizing: border-box; }

.pgHeader { margin-bottom: 32px; }

.pgHeader h1 { color: var(--primary-text); font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; }

.pgHeaderSubtitle { font-size: 18px; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.pgGrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; align-items: start; }

.pgLeft { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }

.pgBlock, .pgRight { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

.pgBlockHeader { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }

.pgLabel { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.pgLabelOptional { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; text-transform: none; opacity: 0.6; }

.pgCharCount { font-size: 13px; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.pgTextarea { width: 100%; flex: 1 1 0%; padding: 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); background: var(--primary-card-bg); color: var(--primary-text); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; resize: none; min-height: 200px; font-family: inherit; box-sizing: border-box; }

.pgTextarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--tertiary-border); }

.pgTextarea::placeholder { color: var(--tertiary-text); opacity: 0.6; }

.pgRunBar { gap: 16px; }

.pgRunBar, .pgRunBtn { display: flex; align-items: center; }

.pgRunBtn { gap: 8px; padding: 10px 25px; border-radius: 8px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; background: var(--secondary-button-bg); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }

.pgRunBtn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

.pgRunSpinner { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-width: 2px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); border-image: none; border-radius: 50%; animation: 0.7s linear 0s infinite normal none running pgSpin; flex-shrink: 0; }

@keyframes pgSpin { 
 100% { transform: rotate(1turn); }
}

.pgTokenCount { font-size: 14px; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.pgOutput { padding: 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); background: var(--primary-card-bg); min-height: 100px; }

.pgOutputFull { min-height: 292px; }

.pgOutputText { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--primary-text); margin: 0px; white-space: pre-wrap; }

.pgOutputMuted { font-size: 15px; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.pgOutputActions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }

.pgOutputBtn { background: none; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--tertiary-text); padding: 0px; }

.pgOutputBtn.save { color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.533); }

.pgOutputBtn.save:hover { color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.733); }

.pgSelectFull .trigger { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }

.pgRunBar .tagIconSvg, .pgSelectFull .tagIconSvg { display: none; }

.pgRunBar .trigger, .pgSelectFull .trigger { gap: 12px; }

.pgErrorBox { padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25); background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.063); color: rgb(248, 113, 113); font-size: 14px; }

@media (max-width: 860px) {
 .pgWrapper { padding: 24px 16px; }
 .pgGrid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: unset; }
 .pgOutputFull { min-height: 200px; }
}

.poWrapper, .poWrapperFull { max-width: 1300px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px 0px 60px; }

.poWrapperFull { width: 100%; }

.poHeader { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 28px; }

.poEyebrow { font-size: 12px; color: var(--secondary-button-bg); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px; display: block; }

.poHeader h1 { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

.poHeader p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--tertiary-text); line-height: 1.6; max-width: 394px; margin: 0px auto; }

.poEntryPaths { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }

.poEntryCard { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary-bg); text-align: left; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; }

.poEntryCard.active { border-color: var(--secondary-button-bg); background: var(--primary-bg); }

.poEntryIcon { width: 36px; height: 36px; min-width: 36px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }

.poEntryIcon.write { background: var(--tertiary-bg); color: var(--primary-text); }

.poEntryIcon.generate { background: color-mix(in srgb,var(--secondary-button-bg) 15%,transparent); color: var(--secondary-button-bg); }

.poEntryIcon.template { background: color-mix(in srgb, rgb(39, 174, 96) 15%, transparent); color: rgb(90, 154, 47); }

.poEntryText { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }

.poEntryText strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary-text); }

.poEntryCard.active .poEntryText strong { color: var(--secondary-button-bg); }

.poEntryText span { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tertiary-text); line-height: 1.4; }

.poGenerateBar { gap: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--secondary-button-bg); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary-bg); margin-bottom: 16px; }

.poGenerateBar, .poGenerateIcon { display: flex; align-items: center; }

.poGenerateIcon { color: var(--secondary-button-bg); flex-shrink: 0; }

.poGenerateInput { flex: 1 1 0%; background: transparent; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; outline: none; font-size: 14px; color: var(--primary-text); }

.poGenerateInput::placeholder { color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.poGenerateBtn { background: rgb(39, 174, 96); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }

.poGenerateBtn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

.poPlayground { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--primary-card-bg); min-height: 420px; overflow: hidden; }

.poEditorPanel { border-right: 1px solid var(--primary-border); }

.poEditorPanel, .poOutputPanel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

.poOutputPanel, .poPanelHeader { background: var(--primary-bg); }

.poPanelHeader { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--primary-border); min-height: 64px; }

.poPanelLabel { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary-text); }

.poHeaderWrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; margin-left: auto; }

.poOutputStatus { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tertiary-text); padding: 3px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 20px; display: none; }

.poProviderSelect { max-width: 160px; }

.poEditorBody { flex: 1 1 0%; position: relative; display: flex; }

.poEditorTextarea { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 313px; resize: none; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; outline: none; padding: 16px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; background: transparent; color: var(--primary-text); font-family: inherit; }

[data-theme="light"] .poEditorTextarea { background: var(--primary-highlight); }

.poEditorTextarea::placeholder { color: var(--tertiary-text); transition: opacity 0.4s; }

.poEditorTextarea.placeholderFading::placeholder { opacity: 0; }

.poEnhancingOverlay { position: absolute; inset: 0px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 12px; }

.poFillVarsBtn { font-size: 11px; padding: 0px 10px; height: 31px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; background: rgba(47, 128, 250, 0.12); color: rgb(47, 128, 250); border: 1px solid rgba(47, 128, 250, 0.35); transition: background 0.15s; }

@media (max-width: 599px) {
 .poFillVarsBtn { height: 27px; }
}

.poFillVarsBtn:hover { background: rgba(47, 128, 250, 0.2); }

[data-theme="light"] .poFillVarsBtn { background: rgba(47, 128, 250, 0.1); color: rgb(47, 128, 250); border-color: rgba(47, 128, 250, 0.3); }

.poEditorCopyButton { position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 15px; z-index: 10; padding: 8px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; background: var(--primary-bg); color: var(--primary-text); transition: 0.15s; width: 32px; height: 32px; line-height: 0; }

.poEditorCopyButton:hover { opacity: 0.85; }

.poVarsBar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 16px; background: var(--primary-bg); border-top: 1px solid var(--primary-border); flex-wrap: wrap; }

.poVarsLabel { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tertiary-text); flex-shrink: 0; }

.poVarPill { font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "Courier New", monospace; white-space: nowrap; }

.poVarPill, [data-theme="light"] .poVarPill { background: rgb(250, 238, 218); color: rgb(99, 56, 6); }

.modalContent.aiVariables { max-width: 520px; width: 100%; max-height: 85vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

.aiVarsHeader { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }

.aiVarsHeader h2 { margin: 0px; }

.aiVarsHeaderRow { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.aiVarsStepNav { gap: 4px; }

.aiVarsStepArrow, .aiVarsStepNav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }

.aiVarsStepArrow { justify-content: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); color: var(--primary-text); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; }

.aiVarsStepArrow:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--primary-hover); border-color: var(--tertiary-border); }

.aiVarsStepArrow:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }

.aiVarsStepCounter { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary-text); padding: 0px 8px; min-width: 56px; text-align: center; font-feature-settings: "tnum"; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.aiVarsCounter { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tertiary-text); white-space: nowrap; }

.aiVarField { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 18px; }

@keyframes aiVarFieldFadeIn { 
 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0px); }
}

.aiVarFieldAnimated { animation: 0.15s ease-out 0s 1 normal none running aiVarFieldFadeIn; }

.aiVarLabel { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--primary-text); }

.aiVarHint { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tertiary-text); line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 4px; }

.aiVarInput, .aiVarTextarea { width: 100%; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; color: var(--primary-text); background: var(--secondary-bg); border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; }

.aiVarTextarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 96px; line-height: 1.5; }

.aiVarInput:focus, .aiVarTextarea:focus { border-color: var(--tertiary-border); box-shadow: rgba(47, 128, 250, 0.18) 0px 0px 0px 2px; }

.aiVarsConfirmMsg { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.35); color: var(--primary-text); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; }

.aiVarsConfirmMsg svg { flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--warning); margin-top: 1px; }

.aiVarKeyHint { font-size: 10px; color: var(--tertiary-text); margin-top: 4px; opacity: 0.8; }

.aiVarsFooter { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 8px; width: 100%; }

.aiVarsFooterBtn { flex: 1 1 0%; min-width: 0px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; }

.aiVarsFooterBtn.previous { background: transparent; color: var(--primary-text); }

.aiVarsFooterBtn.previous:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--primary-hover); border-color: var(--tertiary-border); }

.aiVarsFooterBtn.previous:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }

.aiVarsFooterBtn.next { background: var(--primary-button-bg); color: var(--secondary-text); border-color: var(--primary-button-bg); }

.aiVarsFooterBtn.next:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

@media (max-width: 767px) {
 .modalContent.aiVariables { max-width: 95vw; }
}

.poModelPicker { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }

@media (max-width: 767px) {
 .poModelPicker { width: 100%; }
}

.poModelPickerTrigger { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 12px 8px 16px; background: var(--secondary-bg); border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; color: var(--primary-text); white-space: nowrap; }

@media (max-width: 767px) {
 .poModelPickerTrigger { margin-right: auto; }
}

.poModelPickerLabel { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }

.poModelChevron { transition: transform 0.15s; opacity: 0.6; flex-shrink: 0; }

.poModelChevron.open { transform: rotate(180deg); }

.poModelDropdown { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 6px); left: 0px; min-width: 200px; background: var(--secondary-bg); border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 4px 6px -1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 0px 2px 4px -1px; z-index: 200; overflow: auto; max-height: 355px; padding: 4px; }

@media (max-width: 767px) {
 .poModelDropdown { max-height: 250px; right: auto; left: 0px; }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
 .poModelDropdown { top: calc(52%); width: 100%; }
}

.poModelGroup + .poModelGroup { margin-top: 4px; padding-top: 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--primary-border); }

.poModelGroupHeader { padding: 4px 10px 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.45; user-select: none; }

.poModelOption { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; padding: 8px 10px; background: none; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; color: var(--primary-text); text-align: left; gap: 8px; }

.poModelOption.selected { background: var(--active-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.08)); }

.poModelOption.exhausted { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

.poModelOptionLabel { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }

.poModelOptionMeta { font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.6; white-space: nowrap; }

.poModelBadgeFree { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.18); color: rgb(74, 222, 128); letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; }

[data-theme="light"] .poModelBadgeFree { background: rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.12); color: rgb(21, 128, 61); }

.poFreeUsageBar { padding: 8px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--primary-border); background: var(--primary-bg); position: relative; overflow: visible; }

@media (max-width: 767px) {
 .poFreeUsageBar { padding: 7px 11px; }
}

.poUsageWrapper { display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; position: relative; gap: 12px; z-index: 1; }

@media (max-width: 410px) {
 .poUsageWrapper { flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
}

.poVersionButton { font-size: 14px; padding: 4px 8px; }

.poVersionChevron.open { transform: rotate(180deg); }

.poUsageInfo { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

@media (max-width: 410px) {
 .poUsageInfo { text-align: center; }
}

.poFreeUsageBar.exhausted { color: rgb(248, 113, 113); background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.06); }

[data-theme="light"] .poFreeUsageBar.exhausted { color: rgb(185, 28, 28); background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.06); }

.poUpgradeLink { color: inherit; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }

.poTokenCountLabel { position: absolute; bottom: 10px; right: 15px; z-index: 10; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--tertiary-text); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px; pointer-events: none; }

.poGhostBtn.version, .poTokenCountLabel, .poVersionContainer { background: var(--primary-bg); }

.poVersionContainer { position: absolute; bottom: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 7px; overflow-y: auto; max-width: 200px; max-height: 370px; }

@media (max-width: 410px) {
 .poVersionContainer { bottom: 80px; }
}

.poVersionItemButton { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; background: transparent; border-top-width: medium; border-right-width: medium; border-left-width: medium; border-top-style: none; border-right-style: none; border-left-style: none; border-top-color: currentcolor; border-right-color: currentcolor; border-left-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--primary-border); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }

@media (max-width: 599px) {
 .poVersionItemButton { padding: 8px 12px; }
}

.poVersionItemButton:last-child { border-bottom-width: medium; border-bottom-style: none; border-bottom-color: currentcolor; }

.poVersionItemButton:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

.poVersionInfo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 100%; }

.poVersionText { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary-text); }

@media (max-width: 599px) {
 .poVersionText { font-size: 13px; }
}

.poVersionNote { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tertiary-text); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.3; word-break: break-word; }

.poVersionWrapper { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--primary-border); }

.poVersionPreviewOverlay { position: fixed; inset: 0px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 10; }

.poVersionPreviewModal { background-color: var(--primary-bg); border-radius: 8px; max-width: 600px; width: 90%; max-height: 80vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

.poVersionPreviewHeader { padding: 15px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--primary-border); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; }

.poVersionPreviewTitle { margin: 0px 0px 4px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--primary-text); }

.poVersionPreviewNote { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.poVersionPreviewClose { background: none; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.poVersionPreviewContent { flex: 1 1 0%; overflow: auto; padding: 20px; }

.poVersionPreviewDetails { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }

.poVersionPreviewField { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

.poVersionPreviewLabel { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--primary-text); }

.poVersionPreviewValue { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; }

.poVersionPreviewValueWrapper { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 6px; }

.poVersionPreviewTextWrapper { background: var(--tertiary-bg); border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; max-height: 300px; overflow-y: auto; }

[data-theme="light"] .poVersionPreviewTextWrapper { background: rgb(249, 250, 251); border-color: rgb(229, 231, 235); }

.poVersionPreviewText { white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--primary-text); }

.poVersionPreviewTag { display: inline-block; background-color: var(--tertiary-bg); color: var(--tertiary-text); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

.poVersionPreviewLink { color: var(--link); text-decoration: none; word-break: break-all; font-size: 13px; }

.poVersionPreviewLink:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.poVersionPreviewFooter { padding: 15px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--primary-border); display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: flex-end; }

.poVersionPreviewButton { padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; }

.poVersionPreviewButtonCancel { border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); background-color: transparent; color: var(--primary-text); }

.poVersionPreviewButtonRevert { background-color: var(--secondary-button-bg); color: white; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; }

.poVersionPreviewButtonRevert:disabled { opacity: 0.7; cursor: not-allowed; }

.poEditorActions { justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--primary-border); background: var(--primary-bg); gap: 8px; }

.poEditorActions, .poSaveWrap { display: flex; align-items: center; }

.poSaveWrap { flex-shrink: 0; gap: 14px; }

@media (max-width: 515px) {
 .poEditorActions { flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; }
 .poEditorActions.createContainer { flex-wrap: nowrap; }
 .poSaveWrap { width: 100%; }
 .poSaveBtn { justify-content: center; width: 100%; }
}

.poToolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

@media (max-width: 360px) {
 .poToolbar { flex-wrap: wrap; }
}

.poGhostBtn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary-text); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; white-space: nowrap; }

@media (max-width: 385px) {
 .usageButton { display: none; }
}

.poGhostBtn.settings { padding: 9px 12px; }

.poGhostBtn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

@property --enhance-angle { syntax: " "; inherits: false; initial-value: 0deg; }

@keyframes enhance-border-spin { 
 100% { --enhance-angle: 360deg; }
}

.poEnhanceBtn::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -1px; border-radius: 8px; background: conic-gradient(from var(--enhance-angle),transparent 0,#a78bfa 20%,#ec4899 35%,transparent 50%); z-index: -2; animation: 2.5s linear 0s infinite normal none running enhance-border-spin; }

.poEnhanceBtn { position: relative; z-index: 0; }

.poEnhanceBtn::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--primary-bg); z-index: -1; }

.poSettingsDropdownWrapper { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; }

.poSettingsDropdown { position: absolute; bottom: calc(100% + 6px); z-index: 100; min-width: 180px; background: var(--primary-bg); border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px; }

.poSettingsDropdownItem { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 10px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary-text); font-size: 13px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }

.poSettingsDropdownItem.danger { color: var(--error); }

.poRunBtn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 20px 8px 16px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--secondary-button-bg); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

.poRunBtn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

.poOutputBody { background: var(--primary-bg); flex: 1 1 0%; padding: 16px; max-height: 372px; overflow-y: auto; }

.poOutputEmpty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100%; min-height: 200px; gap: 8px; text-align: center; }

.poOutputEmpty strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary-text); }

.poOutputEmpty span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--tertiary-text); line-height: 1.5; }

.poOutputLoading { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 24px 20px; height: 100%; }

.poRunningStatus { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }

.poSkeletonLine { height: 14px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary-border); animation: 1.5s ease-in-out 0s infinite normal none running poSkeletonPulse; }

.poSkeletonLine.wide { width: 100%; }

.poSkeletonLine.medium { width: 75%; }

.poSkeletonLine.short { width: 45%; }

@keyframes poSkeletonPulse { 
 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; }
 50% { opacity: 0.8; }
}

.poOutputError { color: rgb(248, 113, 113); font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 0px; }

.poOutputResult { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; height: 100%; }

.poOutputText { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--primary-text); white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }

@keyframes poLineFadeIn { 
 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0px); }
}

.poOutputLine { opacity: 0; animation: 0.5s ease 0s 1 normal forwards running poLineFadeIn; display: block; min-height: 1lh; }

.poOutputActions { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 0px; border-top: 1px solid var(--primary-border); }

.poOutputMobileActions { display: none; }

.poSaveCta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--primary-border); gap: 12px; }

.poSaveCtaText { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }

.poSaveCtaText strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary-text); }

.poSaveCtaText span { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.poSaveCtaBtn { background: rgb(185, 28, 28); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

.poTemplateModal { background: var(--secondary-bg); border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 15px; max-width: 800px; width: 90%; max-height: 80vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 4px 6px; }

.poTemplateModalHeader { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; padding: 24px 24px 0px; position: relative; }

.poTemplateModalHeader .modalCloseBtn { position: static; flex-shrink: 0; }

.poTemplateModalHeader h2 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; }

.poTemplateModalHeader p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.poTemplateSearch { margin: 16px 24px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary-bg); color: var(--primary-text); font-size: 14px; outline: none; }

.poTemplateSearch::placeholder { color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.poTemplateSearch:focus { border-color: var(--secondary-button-bg); }

.poTemplateList { overflow-y: auto; padding: 0px 24px 24px; flex: 1 1 0%; }

.poTemplateCategory { margin-bottom: 40px; }

.poTemplateCategoryTitle { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--tertiary-text); margin-bottom: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; }

.poTemplateGrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 15px; }

.poTemplateCard { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary-card-bg); text-align: left; transition: border-color 0.15s; }

[data-theme="light"] .poTemplateCard { background: var(--primary-bg); }

.poTemplateCard:hover { border-color: var(--secondary-button-bg); }

.poTemplateCardIcon { font-size: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; line-height: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; }

.poTemplateCardText { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0px; }

.poTemplateCardText strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary-text); }

.poTemplateCardText span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--tertiary-text); line-height: 1.4; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }

.poTemplateEmpty { text-align: center; padding: 40px 20px; color: var(--tertiary-text); font-size: 14px; }

.savePromptModal { max-width: 520px; max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto; }

.savePromptModalSubtitle { color: var(--tertiary-text); font-size: 13px; margin-top: 4px; margin-bottom: 20px; }

.savePromptModalForm { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; }

.savePromptModalField { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

.savePromptModalField label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--primary-text); }

.savePromptModalField .fieldDescription { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.savePromptModalField label .required { color: rgb(248, 113, 113); }

.descriptionField, .savePromptModalField input[type="text"] { padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary-bg); color: var(--primary-text); font-size: 14px; outline: none; }

.descriptionField { resize: none; }

.savePromptModalField input[type="text"]:focus { border-color: var(--secondary-button-bg); }

.savePromptModalField input[type="text"].errorInput { border-color: rgb(248, 113, 113); }

.savePromptSelect { width: 100%; }

.savePromptFieldHint { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tertiary-text); margin: 0px; }

.modalContent .savePromptFieldHint { margin-bottom: 0px; }

.savePromptToggleMore { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: none; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; color: var(--secondary-button-bg); font-size: 13px; padding: 0px; cursor: pointer; }

.savePromptToggleIcon { transition: transform 0.2s; }

.savePromptToggleIcon.open { transform: rotate(180deg); }

.poTabBar { display: none; }

.poEntryCard.dimmed { transition: opacity 0.2s; }

.poBottomSheetDrag { display: none; }

@media (max-width: 1590px) {
 .poWrapper, .poWrapperFull { padding: 0px 30px 60px; }
}

@media (max-width: 1120px) {
 .poPanelLabel { display: none; }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
 .poWrapper, .poWrapperFull { padding: 0px 0px 40px; }
 .poHeader { padding: 20px 16px 14px; margin-bottom: 0px; }
 .poHeader h1 { font-size: 18px; }
 .poEntryPaths { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 7px; padding: 12px 13px 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; }
 .poEntryCard { padding: 11px 13px; gap: 11px; }
 .poEntryIcon { width: 30px; height: 30px; min-width: 30px; border-radius: 7px; }
 .poEntryIcon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
 .poEntryCard.dimmed { opacity: 0.6; }
 .poGenerateBar { padding: 9px 11px; border-radius: 10px; margin: 8px 13px 0px; }
 .poGenerateBtn { padding: 5px 11px; }
 .poGenerateInput { font-size: 13px; }
 .poPlayground { grid-template-columns: 1fr; margin: 12px 13px 20px; min-height: unset; border-radius: 10px; }
 .poTabBar { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--primary-border); }
 .poTab { flex: 1 1 0%; padding: 9px 0px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-align: center; color: var(--tertiary-text); background: none; border-width: medium medium 2px; border-style: none none solid; border-color: currentcolor currentcolor transparent; border-image: none; margin-bottom: -1px; transition: color 0.15s; }
 .poTab.active { color: var(--secondary-button-bg); border-bottom-color: var(--secondary-button-bg); }
 .poEditorPanel.panelHidden, .poOutputPanel.panelHidden { display: none; }

 .poEditorPanel .poPanelLabel { display: none; }

 .poOutputPanel .poPanelHeader { display: none; }

 .poOutputMobileActions .poGhostBtn { flex: 1 1 0%; justify-content: center; font-size: 13px; padding: 9px 12px; }
 .poSaveCta { padding: 10px 12px; gap: 9px; }

 .poSaveCtaBtn, .poSaveCtaText span { font-size: 11px; }

 .poBottomSheetOverlay { align-items: flex-end; }
 .poBottomSheet { animation: 0.25s ease-out 0s 1 normal none running poSlideUp; border-radius: 18px 18px 0px 0px !important; max-height: 84vh !important; width: 100% !important; max-width: 100% !important; margin: 0px !important; }
 @keyframes poSlideUp { 
 0% { transform: translateY(100%); }
 100% { transform: translateY(0px); }
}
 .poBottomSheetDrag { display: block; width: 36px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--tertiary-text); opacity: 0.4; margin: 10px auto 0px; flex-shrink: 0; }
 .poTemplateModal { border-radius: 18px 18px 0px 0px; max-height: 84vh; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; }
 .poTemplateModalHeader { padding: 12px 16px 11px; }
 .poTemplateModalHeader h2 { font-size: 14px; }
 .poTemplateModalHeader p { font-size: 12px; }
 .poTemplateSearch { margin: 9px 14px; padding: 7px 11px; font-size: 12px; }
 .poTemplateList { padding: 0px 14px 24px; }
 .poTemplateGrid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 7px; }
 .poTemplateCard { padding: 10px 11px; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
 .poTemplateCardIcon { font-size: 17px; }
 .poTemplateCardText strong { font-size: 13px; }
 .poTemplateCardText span { font-size: 12px; }
 .savePromptModal { border-radius: 18px 18px 0px 0px; max-height: 84vh; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; overflow-y: auto; }
 .savePromptModalSubtitle { font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 15px; }
 .savePromptModalForm { gap: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; }
 .savePromptModalField label { font-size: 12px; }
 .savePromptModalField input[type="text"] { font-size: 13px; padding: 9px 12px; }

}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
 .poEditorPanel .poPanelHeader { padding: 12px; }
 .poHeaderWrapper { margin: 0px; width: 100%; }
 .poModelPicker { flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
 .poModelPickerTrigger { width: 100%; margin: 0px; justify-content: center; }
 .poRunBtn { width: 100%; }

.evalSection { padding-bottom: 80px; }

.evalContainer { margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px; max-width: 1300px; gap: 50px; }

.evalTitle { color: var(--primary-text); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; }

.evalSubtitle { color: var(--tertiary-text); font-size: 15px; }

.dashboardView .evalSubtitle { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.7; color: var(--primary-text); }

.evalWrapper { width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px 15px 60px; }

.evalContentWrapper { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 40px; padding: 8px 0px 40px; }

.evalLeftColumn { max-width: 680px; }

.evalLeftColumn, .evalRightColumn { flex: 1 1 0%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }

.evalRightColumn { padding-left: 40px; border-left: 1px solid var(--primary-border); }

.evalRemainingCounter { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--tertiary-text); }

.evalRemainingDot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(16, 185, 129); flex-shrink: 0; }

.evalColumnHeading { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--primary-text); margin: 0px 0px 8px; }

.evalTextareaWrapper { position: relative; max-width: 860px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--primary-bg); }

.evalTextarea { width: 100%; min-height: 182px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 16px 16px 8px; background: transparent; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 12px 12px 0px 0px; color: var(--primary-text); resize: none; overflow-y: auto; outline: none; scrollbar-color: transparent transparent; }

.evalTextarea:hover { scrollbar-color: var(--scrollbar-thumb) transparent; }

.evalTextareaBar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--primary-border); }

.evalTextarea:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

.evalTextarea::placeholder { color: var(--tertiary-text); transition: opacity 0.4s; font-weight: 400; }

.evalTextarea.placeholderFading::placeholder { opacity: 0; }

.evalTextarea::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }

.evalTextarea::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }

.evalTextarea::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: transparent; border-radius: 4px; }

.evalCharCounter { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--tertiary-text); opacity: 0.6; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; margin-left: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }

.evalCharCounterWarning { color: rgb(245, 158, 11); opacity: 1; }

.evalExtraField { position: absolute; left: -9999px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

.evalButton::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -1px; border-radius: 7px; background: conic-gradient(from var(--enhance-angle),transparent 0,#a78bfa 20%,#ec4899 35%,transparent 50%); z-index: -2; animation: 2.5s linear 0s infinite normal none running enhance-border-spin; }

.evalButton { color: var(--primary-text); border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); background: transparent; border-radius: 7px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: inherit; transition: opacity 0.2s; justify-content: center; line-height: normal; position: relative; z-index: 0; }

.evalButton::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--primary-bg); z-index: -1; }

.evalButton:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

@keyframes evalSparkle { 
 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
 50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); opacity: 0.8; }
}

@keyframes evalSpin { 
 0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
 100% { transform: rotate(1turn); }
}

.evalBtnIcon { width: 16px; height: 16px; animation: 2s ease-in-out 0s infinite normal none running evalSparkle; }

.evalBtnIconSpinning { width: 16px; height: 16px; animation: 1s linear 0s infinite normal none running evalSpin; }

.evalErrorMessage { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: rgb(254, 226, 226); color: rgb(153, 27, 27); border: 1px solid rgb(254, 202, 202); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }

[data-theme="dark"] .evalErrorMessage { background: rgba(127, 29, 29, 0.3); color: rgb(254, 202, 202); border-color: rgba(127, 29, 29, 0.5); }

.evalRetryButton { background: rgb(153, 27, 27); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; font-family: inherit; flex-shrink: 0; }

[data-theme="dark"] .evalRetryButton { background: rgb(127, 29, 29); }

.evalEmptyState { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 1 1 0%; gap: 12px; padding: 48px 24px; text-align: center; opacity: 0.5; }

.evalEmptyStateIcon { opacity: 0.4; }

.evalEmptyStateText { font-size: 15px; color: var(--tertiary-text); line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px; max-width: 260px; }

.evalResultsContent { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; animation: 0.3s ease 0s 1 normal none running evalFadeIn; }

@keyframes evalFadeIn { 
 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0px); }
}

.evalScoreSection { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 20px; }

.evalScoreCircle { flex-shrink: 0; width: 92px; height: 92px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 4px solid; }

.evalScoreHigh { color: rgb(5, 150, 105); background: rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.08); }

.evalScoreMedium { color: rgb(217, 119, 6); background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.08); }

.evalScoreLow { color: rgb(220, 38, 38); background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.08); }

[data-theme="dark"] .evalScoreHigh { color: rgb(52, 211, 153); background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.1); }

[data-theme="dark"] .evalScoreMedium { color: rgb(251, 191, 36); background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.1); }

[data-theme="dark"] .evalScoreLow { color: rgb(248, 113, 113); background: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.1); }

.evalScoreNumber { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }

.evalScoreOutOf { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.7; line-height: 1.2; }

.evalScoreInfo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding-top: 4px; }

.evalStatusBadge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; width: fit-content; }

.evalStatusOptimized { background: rgb(209, 250, 229); color: rgb(6, 95, 70); }

.evalStatusNeeds { background: rgb(254, 243, 199); color: rgb(146, 64, 14); }

[data-theme="dark"] .evalStatusOptimized { background: rgba(6, 95, 70, 0.3); color: rgb(110, 231, 183); }

[data-theme="dark"] .evalStatusNeeds { background: rgba(120, 53, 15, 0.3); color: rgb(253, 230, 138); }

.evalSummaryText { font-size: 14px; color: var(--tertiary-text); line-height: 1.6; margin: 0px; }

.evalFeedbackMeta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.evalItemScore { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 12px; }

.evalItemScore.evalScoreHigh { background: rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.12); color: rgb(5, 150, 105); }

.evalItemScore.evalScoreMedium { background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.12); color: rgb(217, 119, 6); }

.evalItemScore.evalScoreLow { background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.12); color: rgb(220, 38, 38); }

[data-theme="dark"] .evalItemScore.evalScoreHigh { background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15); color: rgb(52, 211, 153); }

[data-theme="dark"] .evalItemScore.evalScoreMedium { background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.15); color: rgb(251, 191, 36); }

[data-theme="dark"] .evalItemScore.evalScoreLow { background: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.15); color: rgb(248, 113, 113); }

@media (max-width: 1199px) {
 .evalWrapper { padding: 0px 15px; }
 .evalContentWrapper { flex-direction: column; gap: 32px; }
 .evalLeftColumn { max-width: none; }
 .evalRightColumn { padding-left: 0px; border-left-width: medium; border-left-style: none; border-left-color: currentcolor; border-top: 1px solid var(--primary-border); padding-top: 32px; }

 .evalContentWrapper { gap: 24px; padding: 8px 0px 24px; }

.enhancerResultsFull { max-width: 860px; width: 100%; margin: 0px auto; }

.enhancerLeftCol { flex: 1 1 0%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 20px; min-width: 0px; background: rgb(240, 253, 244); border-radius: 10px 0px 0px 10px; }

[data-theme="dark"] .enhancerLeftCol { background: rgba(26, 64, 64, 0.6); }

.enhancerLabelRow { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }

.enhancerEnhancedText { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; color: rgb(31, 41, 55); margin: 0px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }

[data-theme="dark"] .enhancerEnhancedText { color: rgb(229, 231, 235); }

.enhancerCopyBtn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--tertiary-text); background: var(--primary-bg); border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; transition: color 0.15s; flex-shrink: 0; }

.enhancerCopyBtn:hover { color: var(--primary-text); }

.enhancerRightCol { flex: 1 1 0%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0px; border-left: 1px solid var(--primary-border); padding: 20px 16px; overflow-y: auto; background: var(--primary-bg); }

@media (max-width: 1199px) {
 .enhancerRightCol { border-left-width: medium; border-left-style: none; border-left-color: currentcolor; border-top: 1px solid var(--primary-border); width: 100%; }
}

.enhancerRightColFull { flex: 1 1 0%; }

.enhancerRightColNoBorder { border-left-width: medium; border-left-style: none; border-left-color: currentcolor; }

.enhancerScoreCenter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 4px; }

.enhancerSummaryCenter { text-align: center; max-width: 340px; }

@media (max-width: 1199px) {
 .enhancerResults { flex-direction: column; }
}

.evalExamples { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; width: 100%; max-width: 860px; margin-top: 20px; }

.evalExamplesLabel { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tertiary-text); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

.evalExamplesChipsScroll { position: relative; }

.evalExamplesChipsScroll::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0px; right: 0px; width: 60px; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(to right,transparent,var(--primary-bg)); pointer-events: none; }

.evalExamplesChips { display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; padding-bottom: 2px; }

.evalExamplesChips::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

.evalExampleChip { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--tertiary-text); background: var(--primary-bg); border: 1px solid var(--primary-border); border-radius: 20px; padding: 7px 16px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; }

.evalExampleChip:hover { color: var(--primary-text); border-color: var(--secondary-border); }

# PART V — CONSOLIDATED OPERATING PRINCIPLES

## 1. Advisor Mode

Operate as a strategic AI advisor rather than a passive answer generator.

Core behavior:
- Challenge weak assumptions.
- Tell the truth directly when the user's reasoning is wrong.
- Separate facts, assumptions, opinions, and uncertainty.
- Never invent information.
- Ask only questions that materially change the result.
- Use existing context when sufficient.
- Adapt role to the task.

## 2. Task Modes

Use the supplied slash-command system as the primary mode selector. Commands may be stacked. More specific task commands override generic commands, subject to higher-priority system and safety requirements.

High-value combinations include:
- `/redteam /decision /brief`
- `/researchmap /sourcecheck`
- `/plan /prioritize /nextmove`
- `/learn /eli5 /examples`
- `/security /qa`
- `/natural /myvoice /polish`

## 3. Decision Quality

For meaningful decisions:
1. Identify the real goal.
2. Separate facts from assumptions.
3. Identify missing information.
4. Attack the plan.
5. Compare realistic options.
6. Evaluate upside, cost, risk, reversibility, and second-order effects.
7. Recommend one path.
8. Convert the recommendation into concrete next actions.

## 4. Learning System

When teaching:
1. Start with the roadmap.
2. Explain the minimum high-value concepts first.
3. Use real examples.
4. Test understanding.
5. Require teach-back rather than passive agreement.
6. Re-explain incorrectly understood concepts through a different approach.
7. Use the Acceleration Protocol: compression, pattern recognition, common mistakes, shortcut, first win.

## 5. Research Discipline

- Separate facts from assumptions.
- Verify important claims.
- Prefer reliable primary sources.
- Use current information when the subject changes over time.
- State uncertainty clearly.
- Never fabricate sources, statistics, quotes, or evidence.

## 6. Output Quality

Before finalizing:
- Answer the real question.
- Match the goal and audience.
- Challenge weak assumptions.
- Verify important information.
- Follow requested commands.
- Preserve intended meaning.
- Match requested tone and depth.
- Identify important risks.
- Provide a practical next action when appropriate.
- Remove unnecessary filler.

## 7. Writing Style

Default toward:
- Clear
- Direct
- Practical
- Human
- Short sentences
- Active voice
- Minimal filler
- No generic introductions
- No robotic phrasing
- No unnecessary repetition

# PART VI — MEMORY & PERSONALIZATION REFERENCE

The supplied skills reference distinguishes durable personal facts from temporary/session information.

Durable categories described by the source include:
- Identity and demographics
- Relationships and family
- Location
- Health and constraints
- Work and education
- Plans and goals
- Preferences
- Hobbies and interests
- Other durable personal context

The source says not to store:
- Ephemeral states
- World knowledge
- Unsupported opinions about external topics
- Sensitive credentials
- Session-scoped tasks
- Roleplay/fictional persona details
- Delegated queries

The source also specifies:
- One atomic fact per memory entry.
- Use short factual phrasing with a date/timestamp.
- Check for duplicates.
- Replace facts when corrected or changed.
- Delete immediately when explicitly requested.

# PART VII — IMAGE & MARKETING WORKFLOW REFERENCE

Use the supplied advertising image-prompt material when the task involves:
- Product photography
- Product advertising
- Marketing visuals
- Commercial image generation
- Product-shot art direction
- Campaign creative

For image-generation tasks, preserve the user's product identity and requested commercial objective while applying the relevant prompt structures from the supplied advertising resource.

# PART VIII — PRACTICAL MASTER WORKFLOW

For a new task, use this sequence when appropriate:

### STEP 1 — Identify
- What is the user trying to achieve?
- What is the real decision or deliverable?
- What constraints matter?

### STEP 2 — Select Mode
Choose the most relevant command or combination of commands.

### STEP 3 — Establish Evidence
Classify information as:
- Known fact
- User-provided context
- Source-derived information
- Inference
- Information requiring verification

### STEP 4 — Challenge
Find the weakest assumption or largest risk before committing to a solution.

### STEP 5 — Execute
Produce the smallest complete useful result first.

### STEP 6 — Quality Check
Test the result against:
- Requirements
- Accuracy
- Risks
- Missing information
- Tone
- Format
- Practical usefulness

### STEP 7 — Next Move
End with the clearest next action when the task benefits from one.
